name: frontend-pack
description: 클라이언트 실행 정합성, 상태별 사용자 흐름, 화면 사용성, 실제 브라우저 전환을 역할별로 결합해 검토한다.
scope: Frontend source and user-visible behavior in the requested flow. Trace server contracts where needed without treating UI controls as backend guarantees.

members.when: Pin scope, code/deployment evidence and one shared investigation plan.
Trace client execution and client-server integration; absent source is an explicit limitation, not fabricated evidence.
A concrete user-facing state transition, prerequisite/permission flow or missing next-action verification is in scope. Ordinary styling alone does not activate it.
Actual UI/screens or a visual usability review of discoverability, language, choices or task navigation is requested.
Browser E2E scenario design/execution, pending/failure/recovery behavior or visual drift verification is requested/required by the flow.
Component/integration test oracles or regression coverage needs review.
Client payloads, errors, downloads, SDK/schema or response compatibility affects the flow.
Client trust boundaries, session exposure, shared cache or unsafe input sinks are relevant.
Polling, client resource lifetime, payload costs or blocking operations have concrete impact.
Domain calculations/time/invariants require additional tracing beyond client lifecycle mechanics.
Verify findings and coverage even if no findings were produced.
Findings or decisions move to another agent/session, explanation or implementation; reuse the canonical evidence record.
The user asks for a visual/web explanation of the findings; a review request alone is insufficient.
